name: Rama Paper Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Raama Paper Mills Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of paper and paper products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RPML is in the business of manufacturing and selling paper and board-related products in various segments, including Newsprint, cream woven paper, duplex board, and poster paper.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -44.2% over past five years.
